definitions.explanation: Whether the parts of a story, argument, or explanation fit together logically. Almost always used in the set phrase {辻褄|つじつま}が{合|あ}う (to be consistent) or {辻褄|つじつま}を{合|あ}わせる (to make things consistent).

examples.japanese: ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{辻褄|つじつま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせよう→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ばれる→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧。
examples.english: Even if you try to force the story to be consistent, people will see through it right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{辻褄|つじつま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}っている→合う：10466_au⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧、⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to check once more whether the testimony is consistent.

notes:
Rarely used alone — almost always appears in set phrases. The word comes from sewing terminology: {辻|つじ} (crossroads/seam intersection) + {褄|つま} (hem), referring to whether seams line up properly at their meeting points.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {辻褄|つじつま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (to be consistent, to add up)
- {辻褄|つじつま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧ (to be inconsistent, not add up)
- {辻褄|つじつま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ (to make things consistent, to reconcile)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{辻褄|つじつま} (consistency of a story)
- {辻褄|つじつま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧ (an inconsistent explanation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{整合性|せいごうせい}→整合性：05805_seigousei⟧: consistency, coherence (formal, technical)
- ⟦{筋|すじ}が{通|とお}る→筋が通る：16371_sujigatooru⟧: to make sense, to be logical (focuses on overall logic rather than specific matching)
